expectedOutcome: koala check no longer prints STALE_SAFE .gitignore: missing runtime ignore pattern(s): **/owner-lease.json, .koala/locks/; final main convergence should report converged: true.
actualTranscript: koala check printed Koala managed asset check: OK (profile=all), Summary: OK=45, STALE_SAFE=0. koala validate passed with 3/3 verification intents covered. koala convergence_check only reported B-6375 as active before DONE.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match for koala check. convergence_check will be re-run after DONE on main because active story status is the only remaining difference in TEST.
limitations: none - fully covered; no source/runtime behavior changed.
pitfalls: Initial koala validate failed before build because the story worktree lacked packages/main/dist; running npm --prefix packages/main run build generated ignored dist artifacts and validation then passed.
